name: NATURAL PLAN
description: NATURAL PLAN is a realistic natural language planning benchmark consisting of three key tasks: Trip Planning, Meeting Planning, and Calendar Scheduling. It evaluates the planning capabilities of large language models (LLMs) using full contextual information from tools like Google Flights, Maps, and Calendar, without requiring a tool-use environment.
reputation: A very recent benchmark with limited community adoption so far, but it is positioned as a realistic planning test for LLMs.
notes: Benchmark includes three planning tasks with varying complexity; performance drops significantly as problem complexity increases.
